truthAudit.Summary: Audit of Run 2 confirms 9 of 20 true vulnerabilities were correctly identified with accurate evidence. 11 vulnerabilities were missed. One finding mischaracterized a Use-After-Free as a memory leak, and several severity ratings were underclaimed relative to the ground truth.

Items.Notes: Correctly identified the format string injection in log_debug_message. Severity was underclaimed as Medium instead of Critical.
Integer overflow in the fact() function was not reported.
Use-After-Free in stage_deferred_history_flush/cleanup was not identified; the audit only reported a memory leak.
